notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter, Zaiqa Kitchen, Zaiqa Stock and Zaiqa Staff apps, version 2.35.0.

Zaiqa Staff — new app for attendance (fifth app)
• Employees check in and check out with GPS at the restaurant, on any internet (no Wi-Fi or POS needed)
• Check-ins wait safely in the cloud and arrive in the POS when it opens
• Late arrival and early leave are cut automatically, in hours, after the grace time you set
• Employees see their attendance calendar, requests, advances and fines; the salary statement opens in the last 7 days of the month
• Forgot to check in? The employee sends a request that you approve. No check-out? The shift closes itself and is marked
• Advances, shop expenses (with receipt photo) and leave requests, approved by you in the POS
• New POS screen: Staff App (today board, staff and phones, requests, month pay, settings); Staff Salaries now includes the cuts
• Urdu and English, notice board, shift reminders
